headword: {一本調子|いっぽんちょうし}

definitions.gloss: monotone; monotonous; lacking variety or variation
definitions.explanation: A state where something continues in the same manner without change or variation. Used to describe speech, music, writing, or any activity that lacks dynamic range.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{話|はなし}し{方|かた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一本調子|いっぽんちょうし}だ。
examples.english: His way of speaking is monotonous.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼン→プレゼン：05505_purezen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一本調子|いっぽんちょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{工夫|くふう}した→工夫する：22180_kufuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I made efforts to keep the presentation from becoming monotonous.

examples.japanese: {一本調子|いっぽんちょうし}な⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飽|あ}きて→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The monotonous development continued, and I got bored halfway through.

notes:
USAGE:
Can be used as a noun or as a な-adjective ({一本調子|いっぽんちょうし}な). Generally carries a negative nuance, implying something is boring or uninspiring due to lack of variation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一本調子|いっぽんちょうし}な{話|はなし}し{方|かた} (monotonous way of speaking)
- {一本調子|いっぽんちょうし}な⟦{展開|てんかい}→展開：04542_tenkai⟧ (monotonous development/progression)
- {一本調子|いっぽんちょうし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become monotonous)
- {一本調子|いっぽんちょうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧ (to avoid monotony)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{単調|たんちょう}→単調：11832_tanchou⟧: monotonous, tedious — more common in everyday speech
- ⟦{平坦|へいたん}→平坦：12475_heitan⟧: flat, even — can describe monotonous writing or terrain
